heading: Your Questions About Arizona Biltmore Dentistry, Answered
subheading: From scheduling your first visit to understanding your treatment options, here's what Phoenix patients ask Dr. Jeziorski most.

items.q: How do I schedule my first appointment at Arizona Biltmore Dentistry?
items.a: You can call our Phoenix office directly at (602) 957-8200 to schedule a new patient appointment. We see patients of all ages, so whether you're coming in solo or bringing the whole family, we can accommodate everyone's needs. We also offer convenient hours to fit busy schedules.

items.q: Do you see children as well as adults?
items.a: Yes — Arizona Biltmore Dentistry welcomes patients of all ages. We provide comprehensive children's exams and cleanings, including cavity risk assessments and brushing and flossing instruction for kids and their parents. Dr. Jeziorski and the team work hard to make younger patients feel comfortable and at ease from the moment they walk in.

items.q: What payment and financing options do you offer?
items.a: Our office offers financing options to make procedures like dental implants accessible to more patients. Cost for treatments such as implants varies based on the type and number needed, so we encourage you to call (602) 957-8200 to discuss your specific situation. We're committed to providing comfortable and affordable dental care to the Phoenix community.

items.q: What can I expect during my first visit?
items.a: At Arizona Biltmore Dentistry, we go above and beyond to make you feel relaxed from the moment you arrive. Your first visit typically includes a comprehensive exam and, when appropriate, digital X-rays that deliver images immediately for faster, more accurate care. Dr. Jeziorski will take the time to understand your dental history, discuss any concerns, and outline a personalized treatment plan.

items.q: Am I a candidate for dental implants?
items.a: If you're missing one or more teeth and in good general health, you're likely a good implant candidate. Dr. Jeziorski will assess your specific situation during your initial consultation.

items.q: What are my tooth replacement options with dental implants?
items.a: Options range from single-tooth implants to full mouth restorations and denture stabilization, all tailored to meet your needs.

items.q: What is the All-on-4 procedure, and is it right for me?
items.a: All-on-4 is a revolutionary implant procedure that completely replaces an entire arch of teeth using only four implants — making it a life-changing option for patients who have lost most or all of their teeth. It's often a more efficient and cost-effective alternative to replacing each tooth individually. Dr. Jeziorski can evaluate whether All-on-4 is the right fit for you during a consultation at our Phoenix office.

items.q: What should I do if I have a dental emergency in Phoenix?
items.a: If you're experiencing a dental emergency such as severe tooth pain, a broken tooth, or swelling, call Arizona Biltmore Dentistry right away at (602) 957-8200. We make every effort to see urgent patients as quickly as possible. Prompt care can make a significant difference in protecting your oral health and relieving discomfort.
